changes_made.explanation: Normalized task names and dataset names. Removed generic model names (LLaMA-2, LLaMA-3) and kept specific model variants. Consolidated output descriptions to be more concise.
Added 'Accuracy' which is used throughout the paper. Normalized 'Exact Match (EM)' to 'Exact Match' and removed duplicate.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used in this paper. The paper only uses LLMs for generation, not for evaluation.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluation is done using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on hyperparameter optimization for LLM inference, specifically evaluating decoding parameters like temperature, top-p, etc. It uses automatic evaluation metrics (Exact Match, Pass@1, Accuracy) on NLG tasks (question answering and code generation) but does not use LLM-as-judge or human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of names and removal of redundant items.
